required: H is a nonsingular genus-3 hyperelliptic curve y^2=f(x) with squarefree degree 7 or 8 f
the factorization type admits a Frobenius-stable perfect matching
the corresponding rational isogeny can be explicitly constructed
the codomain C is nonsingular and non-hyperelliptic
applicability.screen_only: The included program proves the combinatorial rational-kernel condition; it does not construct phi or certify C.

not_claimed: a generic break of NIST prime-field curves
eligibility of a cover whose equation was not supplied
claim.statement: For an eligible genus-3 hyperelliptic Jacobian over F_q, transfer through a rational (2,2,2)-isogeny to a non-hyperelliptic plane quartic and apply Diem index calculus.
claim.status: published asymptotic reduction; user-cover instantiation open

cost.same_field_warning: If an elliptic curve and its genus-3 cover both live over F_p, O(p) is worse than elliptic Pollard rho O(p^(1/2)); a smaller descent field is essential for an ECDLP reduction.

cover_lifted_retraction.complexity_interpretation: reduces back to the original ECDLP; does not beat the original ECDLP
cover_lifted_retraction.exclusion: arbitrary classes in J_H, especially Prym components, do not receive this certificate
cover_lifted_retraction.recovery: [(2d)^(-1) mod n] o f_* o phi^dagger when gcd(2d,n)=1
cover_lifted_retraction.scope: only points in the transported elliptic subgroup f^*E[n]
cover_lifted_retraction.smith_composition: f_* o phi^dagger o phi o f^* = [2d]

coverage_model.assumptions: Smith's random-curve hypotheses, including a modeled 1/4 success for each tractable kernel
coverage_model.interpretation: an asymptotic modeled population fraction, not a guarantee for a supplied curve

open_obligations: obtain the actual cover equation and cover/descent map
implement and verify the induced f^* and f_* maps on the target subgroup
construct and verify phi and the plane quartic C
verify the transported subgroup order and nonzero images
benchmark relation collection and sparse linear algebra at the target size

preservation_certificate.consequence: phi is injective on G_H and preserves the discrete logarithm
preservation_certificate.intersection_argument: |G_H intersect ker(phi)| divides both n and 8, hence is 1

typed_graph.obligation: supply and verify the cover/descent map and its kernel on G
typed_graph.source: ECDLP subgroup G of odd prime order n

typed_graph.destination: J_C for a non-hyperelliptic genus-3 plane quartic C
typed_graph.kernel: rational maximal isotropic (Z/2Z)^3 generated by a Frobenius-stable perfect matching of the eight Weierstrass points
typed_graph.source: J_H for H: y^2=f(x), deg(f) in {7,8}
